title: Practice 5: за-: behind, and dropping in

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Лука Силыч опять ___ (залетать / залететь — to fly; past m. sg.) по комнатам.
exercises.why: **залетал** — past tense (masculine) of залетать: imperfective (perfective partner: залететь).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).

exercises.q: По доброй воле сюда не ___ (заехать / заезжать — to drive into; 2nd sg.)!
exercises.why: **заедешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of заехать: perfective (imperfective partner: заезжать).  Prefix **за-**: movement behind an object; stopping off on the way (в / на / за + acc.; к + dat.; за + inst).
